title: DG Matrix, which builds solid-state transformers to handle up to 2.4 MW and boost data center power efficiency, raised a $60M Series A led by Engine Ventures (Tim De Chant/TechCrunch)
summary: Tim De Chant / TechCrunch: DG Matrix, which builds solid-state transformers to handle up to 2.4 MW and boost data center power efficiency, raised a $60M Series A led by Engine Ventures — Data centers face a conundrum: how to power increasingly dense server racks using equipment that relies on century-old technology.
